title: National War Memorial
subject: English
summary: “National War Memorial” is a chapter about the National War Memorial in New Delhi, which was built to honour the brave soldiers who sacrificed their lives for our country. It reminds us of the courage, bravery and dedication of our soldiers who protect our nation. The memorial has different sections and walls with the names of soldiers who gave their lives while defending India. The Amar Jawan Jyoti is a symbol of respect and remembrance for these brave heroes. The chapter teaches us to respect our soldiers and feel proud of their sacrifices. It reminds us that we should always be thankful to the brave soldiers who protect our country and keep us safe.
